name: ametller
description: Find Ametller groceries with photos and manage your shopping cart.
long_description: Local Rust MCP for macOS on Apple Silicon. Browse products with embedded photos, compare pack sizes and estimated prices, and change your cart when requested. Reuses the local Ametller CLI session in macOS Keychain. Guest browsing works before login. Checkout and payment remain on Ametller's website. No browser, Homebrew, or language runtime is required to run this bundle.

locale.title: Catalogue language
locale.description: Enter es for Spanish or ca for Catalan.

tools.name: authentication_status
tools.description: Check the locally saved Ametller connection.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find groceries with embedded photos, pack sizes and estimated prices.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Inspect one product, its photo, description and quantity rules.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the actual cart without creating a basket.

tools.name: set_cart_item
tools.description: Set an explicitly selected item's cart quantity; no checkout or payment.
